Website Terms

This website provides general information about PROCARE INSURANCE and a way to contact our team about insurance, renewals, and claim assistance.

Information and enquiries

Website content is general guidance and does not constitute a policy, binding quotation, offer of cover, or guarantee. Submitting a form prepares a WhatsApp message. An enquiry is not sent to Procare until you send that message in WhatsApp.

Insurance decisions

Read the insurer’s proposal, schedule, policy wording, benefits, exclusions, waiting periods, and other applicable terms before choosing cover. Coverage begins according to the issued policy’s terms. Availability and eligibility vary by insurer and product.

External services

WhatsApp, Google Maps, Google Fonts, and the hosting service operate under their own terms and privacy policies. Phone links may open your device’s calling application. This website has no customer login, payment facility, or document-upload service.

Responsible use

Provide accurate enquiry details and use the website lawfully. Do not attempt to interfere with the website or send information you are not entitled to share.

Questions

Contact PROCARE INSURANCE at +91 9061 6666 07 for clarification about our services.
